bullets.text: The office should review safety concerns regarding the MRTS elevated transport corridor proposed decades ago in Chennai.
Residents in Velachery flagged safety risks after silt cleared from canals was piled up along city roads.
The Greater Chennai Corporation deployed drones and set up control rooms for flood preparedness ahead of heavy rain.
Police exhumed the body of an omni bus cleaner near Cholavaram in Thiruvallur district fifteen days after he went missing.
Telangana unveiled an AI avatar of its IT minister to create a digital interface between citizens and public leadership.
MeitY directed industry bodies to strengthen certification processes and carry out regular security audits to reduce risks.
A public event involving actor Dhanush was hosted on land belonging to a minister's family on OMR after venues were unavailable.

stories.title: When safety slips through a gaping hole
takeaways: The Mass Rapid Transit System in Chennai faces ongoing safety concerns along its elevated corridors.
Local infrastructure challenges in the Velachery corridor require careful administrative monitoring and intervention.

stories.title: Residents flag safety risk as silt removed from canals piles up along city roads
takeaways: Residents of Velachery and other Chennai areas flagged severe safety risks from silt piled up along roadsides.
Locals demanded immediate clearance of dredged canal debris before further heavy rainfall causes blockages.

stories.title: Chennai Corporation readies drones, zonal control rooms ahead of heavy rain forecast
takeaways: The Greater Chennai Corporation deployed drones and control rooms across zones for incoming heavy rains.
Authorities aim to prevent severe waterlogging and ensure rapid response during the monsoon.

stories.title: Couple found dead at Ambattur home
takeaways: A married couple was found dead in their Padi home in Ambattur due to reported unemployment and personal distress.
Local police recovered a suicide note and initiated an inquiry into the tragic domestic incident.

takeaways: Telangana unveiled an AI avatar of its IT minister D. Sridhar Babu at Hyderabad DevFest as a public interface.
The digital tool creates an innovative communication channel between citizens and government leadership.
